blurb: The fastest thing on the map: one rider, no gun, drifts like a hovercraft

notes.model: TNR 1017 (Meshy Community, CC0; content/guns.json vehicles/tnr_hover_bike.glb, 2026-11-10): a one-seat hover bike with handlebars, stub wings and twin thrusters, 3.0 m long. Its wings stand 0.16 m out of the box either side (not solid). The Space Kit speeder it replaced is the fallback (vehicles/hover_bike.glb).
notes.seats: In the saddle (measured on the model: the saddle dips to 1.0-1.1 m at z 0.1-0.5, the tank ahead of it 1.4 m): the nose (+Z) leads and the twin thrusters trail. The rider sits astride the saddle (2026-11-11: they stood on it), thighs turned out either side.
notes.cockpitEye: A seated head height over the saddle, so the nose shows below the view (the default stood a head higher).
